description: Dual-Lane Code Mode sandboxed runner: execute multi-step With Silex RPC scripts with env.LOADER globalOutbound:null isolation (or zero-eval fallback), $0.02 default spend cap, <=25 calls, <=64 KB output, and consolidated HTTP 402 rollup quotes.

code.description: Async script invoking request(path, opts) against With Silex routes.

dryRun.description: Return consolidated HTTP 402 rollup quote without settling.

maxScriptSpendUsd.description: Cumulative spend cap in USD (default 0.02; >0.02 requires signed mandate).

silexPass.description: Optional Silex 0ms Prepaid Bearer Pass token (spass_...).

spendMandateSignature.description: Optional HMAC/N402 spend mandate signature authorizing >$0.02.

steps.description: Optional structured step list [{ path, method, headers, body }].

txHash.description: Optional 64-hex Nano ($XNO) mainnet send block hash for paid HTTP 402 payload unlock.

name: silex_execute
